title: Ysabel Ortega eyes music debut; Kyline Alcantara ‘undecided’ with music pursuit

blocks.text: Ysabel Ortega is gearing up to pursue a music career, with plans to release her first single before the year ends, while Kyline Alcantara is still considering whether to officially pursue a career as a recording artist. Ortega shared the update while walking the red carpet of the Filipino Music Awards 2026 on Tuesday, Oct. 6, where she expressed her excitement about being surrounded by artists she looks up to. “I’ve always been a fan of OPM. Siyempre, i-celebrate natin ‘yung sariling atin,” Ortega told reporters. “As someone na pangarap din maging parte ng industriya at maging aspiring singer, I’m just […]...
